description: This circular walk follows the Fir Trail in Thetford Forest. The waymarked trail follows a series of peaceful woodland trails and also visits the 15th century Thetford Warren Lodge. The lodge is an English Heritage property which protected gamekeepers and hunting parties against armed poachers. You can start the walk from the High Lodge car park where there's also a handy visitor information centre. From here follow the yellow markers east through Downham Highlodge Warren to visit the ancient Thetford Warren Lodge.
